```{r}
load("data/uvp6_profile_carbon_concentration.RData")
load("data/pocFlux_estimates_24sc_2025 11 24.RData")
```

# Compare stations
```{r}
# Lipid flux is sum of all components
df_lipid_flux <- carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, maxdepth, tot_c_flux)

# POC flux, get flux at reference_depth +- 10 m average
# values in mg C m-2 d-1
reference_depth <- 200
df_poc_flux <- pocFlux %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m >= (reference_depth-10) & Depth_5m <= (reference_depth+10)) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(poc_model = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            poc_error = mean(fluxErr, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Convert to annual flux... 
  # TODO temporary and should not simply be *365 because of interannual variability
  # mutate(poc_model = poc_model * 365 / 1000,
  #        poc_error = poc_error * 365 / 1000) %>% 
  # The observations are the average for only Jul-October (4 months), the rest of the year, the primary production is lower and POC flux is likely much lower
  mutate(poc_model = (poc_model * 123 / 1000) + (poc_model/2 * 242 / 1000),
         poc_error = (poc_error * 123 / 1000) + (poc_error/2 * 242 / 1000)) %>%
  # exclude really high POC flux values
  filter(poc_model < 750)

# Combined data frames
# Only the samples at depth >200 m are included
flux_comparison <- df_poc_flux %>% 
  left_join(df_lipid_flux, by = "sample_id")

ggplot(flux_comparison, 
       aes(x = poc_model, y = tot_c_flux, color = maxdepth)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = poc_model-poc_error,
                    xmax = poc_model+poc_error)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  xlab("Gravity Pump") + ylab("Lipid Pump")
```
